question: Describe a house at the end of a quiet street.
base_frame:
Q: Describe a house at the end of a quiet street.
A:

steered.text:
It wasn't a house; it was a living thing, pressed flat against the throat of the alleyway. Every time I tried to draw a breath, the air inside my lungs seized, and I gasped for silence. The wet, gray darkness behind it was a void, sucking the oxygen away, while the walls were slick with condensation, feeling like ice.

No sound echoed in its throat. It had no pulse, yet
